citations.claim: body 0 position and velocity are non-finite (NaN) at the first violating step
one step before, body 0 sits exactly on the final waypoint with near-zero velocity and near-zero controller force

counterfactual.change: Moved final waypoint x from 19.326593994027714 to 19.0 (one field) so the vehicle never settles at exactly zero distance to the target; scenario runs full 2302 steps with no violation.

explanation: Controller NaN when the hover vehicle settles exactly onto its final waypoint: at step 2301 body 0 is at (19.32659,7.58522), identical to waypoint 2, with speed ~2e-13 and controller force ~6e-12; at step 2302 its x/y/vx/vy are all non-finite. Likely the waypoint-seeking law normalizes the zero displacement vector (0/0) or divides by zero distance, producing NaN force/velocity that integrates into NaN position. Disabling the controller or shifting the waypoint removes the failure.
vision_note: Steps 2299 to 2301 show a red circle held stationary at the right edge while a blue circle rests near the bottom and the wall stays fixed. At step 2302 the red circle vanishes completely while the wall, blue circle and green waypoint crosses remain.
